The '''Hull Reinforcement Package''' is an optional internal module that adds a flat amount of hull integrity to a ship, along with a resistance bonus to kinetic, thermal, and explosive damage.

== Overview ==

Unlike [[Armour]] (Bulkheads), which scales hull integrity by a percentage, a Hull Reinforcement Package adds a fixed amount regardless of the ship's base hull. Because it competes for an optional internal slot with modules like [[Cargo Rack|Cargo Racks]] or [[Shield Generator|Shield Generators]], fitting one is a tradeoff most Commanders make deliberately for combat-oriented or higher-risk builds rather than by default.
